item.title: Budget 2026: Sitharaman announces Rs 10,000 crore to boost SME sector
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced Rs 10,000 crore to boost Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in the Union Budget 2026 on Sunday, February 1.

item.title: Healthcare Budget 2026–27: Policy, infra, manufacturing gains prominence
item.description: As Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman presented the budget in Parliament, the emphasis on health came through in measures aimed at manufacturing, workforce capacity and regulatory reform—areas that policymakers believe will shape the system over the next decade.

item.title: Budget 2026 ignites Orange Economy: 15,000 school labs to unleash young creators
item.description: Budget 2026 unleashes India’s orange economy with AVGC labs in 15,000 schools and 500 colleges via Mumbai’s IICT. Eastern youth get creative boost for jobs in animation, gaming. FM Sitharaman’s big bet on skilling millions for global content dominance.

item.title: ISRO conducts sub-scale LOX-Methane engine thrust chamber test
item.description: ISRO has successfully conducted a sub-scale test of LOX-Methane engine. These engines are necessary for the next generation of launchers.

item.description: India’s 2026-27 Union Budget declares Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities as new growth engines. Finance Minister Sitharaman’s historic budget prioritizes massive infrastructure scale-up, supporting over 51 per cent of MSMEs.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: LRS TCS for overseas education slashed from 5 per cent to 2 per cent
item.description: New Delhi: In the Union Budget 2026–27 presented on February 1, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a major relief for students and families sending money abroad. The Tax Collected at Source (TCS) under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) for overseas education and medical expenses has been reduced from 5 per cent to 2 per cent. […]
